findings.correction: “Because they trust me.” / “What?” / “They trust my instincts, and they trust my eye for people. That’s why I want to hold on to Jin Taekyung.”
findings.current: “Because I trust you.” / “What?” / “I trust my instincts, and I trust my eye for people. That’s why I want to hold on to Jin Taekyung.”
findings.defect: 저를 믿으니까요 is others trusting Choi, not Choi trusting Taekyung. The omitted subject of 제 촉을 믿고 is the same: they trust his instinct and eye for people.
findings.rationale: 저 is Choi. 믿으니까요 takes 저 as object. “I trust you” reverses who is trusted and why the Guild can offer B-rank terms.
findings.source: “저를 믿으니까요.” / “네?” / “제 촉을 믿고, 사람 보는 눈을 믿습니다. 그래서 진태경 씨를 꼭 잡고 싶어요.”

findings.defect: He corrects Choi’s praise of his eye: the System is what’s good. The draft makes the System the chooser.
findings.rationale: He used Item check, then chose. 시스템이 좋은 거다 is attribution of quality, not agency.

findings.correction: Render each panel as a blockquote headed `> **System**`, no square brackets on UI terms; e.g. Exiting Sleep Mode. / Afflicted with the status ailment Hangover. / Beginning Qi Circulation. Same frame for Item Window fields.
findings.current: Ding. / - Exiting [Sleep Mode]. / - Status ailment: [Hangover]. / - Beginning [Qi Circulation]. / Item Window / [Lizardman Hunter’s Leather Set] …
findings.defect: System notices and item windows are dash lists with square-bracket UI terms, not `> **System**` blockquotes. Consecutive panel lines are not kept in one window.
findings.rationale: Binding Markdown: actual System panels use one `> **System**` blockquote; do not enclose System UI terms in square brackets.
findings.source: 띠링. / - [수면 모드]를 종료합니다. / - 상태 이상, [숙취]에 걸렸습니다. / - [운기조식]을 시작합니다. / 아이템창 / [리자드맨 사냥꾼의 가죽 세트] …

findings.rationale: 천천히 would be slowly. Manner of waking is hushed, matching sneaking out of Sleep Mode.

findings.correction: The Association probably didn’t disclose all of it, since it’s personal information.
findings.current: The Association probably didn’t open all of that since it’s personal information.
findings.defect: 오픈 is disclose/release; “open all of that” is a loanword calque.
findings.rationale: Meaning is intact; the English collocation is not.
findings.source: 개인 정보라 협회에서도 전부 오픈하지는 않았을 텐데.

findings.correction: As I conceded the point, Team Leader Choi handed me something.
findings.current: As I nodded in agreement, Team Leader Choi handed me something.
findings.defect: 수긍하는 is assent, not a specified nod.
findings.rationale: Small action verbs are not to be added when the source does not specify them.
findings.source: 수긍하는 내게 최 팀장이 뭔가를 내밀었다.

summary: Critical subject reversal in Choi’s explanation of the B-rank terms (Guild trusts him, not “I trust you”). Major: “The System picked it” replaces a self-correction about the System’s quality; System/item UI is not in required blockquote panels and keeps square brackets.
